notes: The scribe's name is damaged: "hemā〇krana" has a gap or mark in the middle, so the reading Hemākrana is uncertain (perhaps Hemākara or Hemākṣara). The colophon names no commissioner, king or other persons. The place reads "sayava tola in Tarumura Mahāvihāra, Raraṃkṛta vihāra"; "dakṣanadisagṛha" (house) is the scribe's residence. The Newari closing "thvakuhnu sidhu juroḥ" means "completed on this day". The catalogue fields are empty, so there are no conflicts to note.
